description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Holy 3 with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Beatrix (Holy)] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Beatrix (Holy)
description.text: Increases [Holy Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Beatrix (Holy) after using a Holy ability (max 4), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Seiken Shock+
description.text: One single ranged attack (7.50) capped at 99999 with 100% hit rate

description.name: Seiken Climhazzard+
description.text: Six single attacks (1.20/1.25 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Beatrix (Holy)
description.text: Two single attacks (0.60 each) with 100% hit rate, causes [Imperil Holy 10% (5s)]

description.name: Attach Holy 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
